steps.prompt: New quest: read {quest} (and the code it cites). Write the spec to {run}/spec.md following your role card: exact signatures (new src/pm/view.cljc, the pm.bridge /view validation, the pm.three centre ray, the pm.lot additions), numbered test cases with hand-checked expected values, and a who-touches-what table (builder: src/pm/view.cljc, src/pm/bridge.cljc, src/pm/three.cljs, src/pm/core.cljs, src/pm/lot.cljc, scripts/crew_bridge.clj, scripts/blueprint_draft.clj, new scripts/where.clj, bb.edn's new task; tester: new test/pm/view_test.cljs plus additions to test/pm/lot_test.cljs and the existing bridge test file, only adding tests; le-docteur: a TASKS.md row T-19 only; Hal updates the role cards himself). Reply when it's written.

prompt.un-automate-monde: Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Implement it in the source files the spec assigns the builder, and nothing else. Run .crew/gate.sh before replying, then write {run}/builder-notes.md as the quest's Done-when says (hand tests only with PM_BLUEPRINTS_FILE on a temp copy and --dry-run; never write state/).
prompt.le-testeur: Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Write its test cases in the test file the spec assigns the tester, and nothing else. The builder is coding in parallel.

steps.prompt: Run the gate (.crew/gate.sh) and write the gate note to {run}/gate-note.md as your role card says.

Review the round's changes against {run}/spec.md and {quest}: git diff for edited files, and read the new files (git status lists them). Check in particular: /view has the same token/origin/size guards as /hold and refuses every malformed field; successful /view posts aren't logged; state/view.edn is written atomically; the game never posts in the demo build, with the bridge off, or while a post is in flight, and throttles as the quest says; pm.view and pm.lot stay pure (now is an argument); --near here / --near <walker> refuse a stale or missing view with a readable line; tests never touch state/; no person, pet or member named in code; no npm deps. Write the review to {run}/review.md.
Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Make only the documentation edits the spec's who-touches-what table gives le-docteur (if none, change nothing). Reply with git diff --stat of what you changed.
